title: Kolvar's Offer
description: Kolvar's parliamentary assistant has confirmed the offer is still on the table. Thirty Halvekist votes in exchange for a modified emergency powers provision. He has been patient. The offer won't last past the committee deadline.

title: Constitutional Draft — Emergency Powers Article
description: The emergency powers provision is the sticking point. Theron's draft limits them sharply. Kolvar's bloc wants them preserved. The compromise language is being drafted now.

title: Budget Allocation — Convention Costs
description: The convention is approaching the fiscal quarter boundary. Adjust allocations to accommodate extended negotiations and the growing security presence around the Great Hall.

title: Church Coordination — Early Warning
description: Danika's office has intercepted parish-level communications suggesting coordinated messaging against the secular provisions in the draft. The Archbishop hasn't issued a public statement yet. That's deliberate.

title: Reformist Caucus — Fracture Risk
description: Twelve reformist MPs are threatening to sit as independents if Kolvar's amendments are accepted. Theron is trying to hold them. He needs to know where you stand before he can make his case.

title: The Son Comes
description: Aleksei Morvec has arrived at the palace without an appointment. He is waiting in the anteroom. He has been waiting for forty minutes. He does not seem bothered.

title: The Floor Vote
description: The Assembly votes on the constitution.
